differences.a_observable: Camera is positioned close to the 'Secure Payments' card, framing it centrally with a yellow card visible at the bottom.
differences.b_observable: Camera is further away and at a shallower angle, with no yellow card visible at the bottom.

differences.a_observable: White background tiles have a bright appearance with subtle blue reflections.
